videos.description: The Houston Texans host the Indianapolis Colts in NFL regular-season play at Reliant Stadium. Indianapolis won the first matchup this year, 19-17, but Houston has won four of the past five meetings in the series to hold the recent head-to-head edge.

videos.title: Live: NFL GameDay Morning
videos.description: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. Joining Eisen is Super Bowl champion Kurt Warner, former NFL head coach Steve Mariucci, and special guests each week to break down the matchups. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.

videos.title: NFL GameDay Live
videos.description: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays. But the program is about more than the action; it intersperses highlights of press conferences, interviews with players and coaches, and live reports by announcers at game sites.

videos.title: Live: Good Morning Football
videos.description: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.
